title: Australian Government Helps Workers Take Time Off for GTA 6 Launch
description: An Australian government office has posted advice to help gamers who want to take time off to play Grand Theft Auto 6 on November 19.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Australian Government Helps Workers Take Time Off for GTA 6 Launch

As the highly anticipated release date of Grand Theft Auto 6 approaches, the excitement within the global gaming community continues to reach unprecedented heights. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet GameRant, an Australian government office has stepped up in an unexpected way by posting advice that may help gamers who want to take time off to play GTA 6 when it launches on November 19.

### Official Advice for Dedicated Gamers

For many adult gamers, the launch of a monumental title like GTA 6 is a major event that calls for uninterrupted playtime. However, securing time off work to dive into a massive open-world game can sometimes be a tricky endeavor. The advice provided by the Australian government office offers a timely, lighthearted, or practical perspective for fans looking to clear their schedules for the big release.

While the exact details of the guidance aim to assist workers, the mere fact that a government office is addressing the phenomenon highlights just how massive the cultural footprint of Grand Theft Auto 6 truly is. Video games of this scale rarely prompt such widespread mainstream engagement before they even hit store shelves.

### Preparing for November 19

With the release date firmly set for November 19, players around the world are already beginning to map out their schedules. Securing annual leave, wrapping up professional commitments, and clearing personal calendars are all part of the preparation process for fans eager to experience Rockstar Games' latest masterpiece on day one.

As anticipation builds, players everywhere will be looking for the best ways to balance their real-world responsibilities with their passion for gaming. Thanks to this recent piece of advice, Australian fans might just have an easier time navigating the delicate art of requesting time off.

## Editor's Take

It is fascinating to see GTA 6 transcend the boundaries of standard entertainment and influence everyday life to the point where government offices are chiming in on leave strategies. November 19 is shaping up to be a historic day for the gaming industry. If you are planning to join the virtual streets on launch day, taking a cue from these official tips might just save you some workplace hassle.
